description: Source code for an OpenH264 video decoder implementation, including initialization, decoding, flushing, and error handling logic within the starboard shared namespace.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing a video decoder for H264 streams using OpenH264, managing decoding lifecycle, input buffers, and output frames.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callback functions for status and error reporting.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, stopping decoding and clearing buffers.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Creates and initializes the OpenH264 decoder instance.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Destroys the decoder instance and releases resources.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Accepts input buffers for decoding, scheduling decoding tasks.

methods.name: DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer, handling key frames and configuration changes.

methods.name: FlushFrames
methods.description: Flushes remaining frames from the decoder buffer.

methods.name: ProcessDecodedImage
methods.description: Processes a decoded frame, creating video frame objects and managing output queue.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream, flushing remaining frames.

methods.name: DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream decoding and final flush.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Creates or updates the decode target for rendering.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target for rendering in decode-to-texture mode.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error via callback, scheduling if called from a different thread.
